name: AI for Executives: Strategy, Value and Risk
description: Work through one company's AI year as its executive sponsor. Test vendor claims on your own data, rank a portfolio by defended value, make the sourcing and GPU calls, rescue a stalled rollout, govern risk and law, and prove ROI to a skeptical CFO, then play seven Decision Labs and build the board pack.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Executives: Strategy, Value and Risk

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 18 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 15 questions, 30 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
